test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fca8433b19ee3c3c4a74d440e8a686a0a12e068de2a92aae6c7430d40ead132d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a8488173579587797cab91a185885399dbd9ed06c28a5037d392a01cf3a9ed1.png] 

2) Second box series →

No change in the 1st row elements.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/964df5aa4d394fbda8f1d282af0057f06126629f5eab7c69cf0a774602dacfd1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3562591f17880a70a32225ffab5fa41085624b0e57bdd01b9c7f907c1eaee3d9.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
